title: STEM 3
learning_outcomes_intro: After successfully completing the module, students will be able to

items: distinguish between different actors and sensors (such as a camera).
understand how sensors (such as a camera), actors and a single-board computer (SBC) / microcontroller (MCU) are constructed and work.
understand basic concepts of image processing.
understand a system of sensors, actors and SBC/MCU.
run and test computer vision algorithms on a system.
connect sensors and actors to an SBC/MCU and put them into operation.
derive prerequisites for the use of computer vision algorithms and other information processing methods.
understand requirements and challenges of systems consisting of sensors, actors and SBC/MCU.
